title: Lead
typeLocked: The lead type cannot change after creation.

type.label: Lead type
type.hint: Choose whether this lead is an individual person or a company.

switchType.title: Change the lead type?
switchType.text: The details that belong only to the current type will be cleared.

name.hint: The first name is required. Up to 80 characters for each part of a person's name, or 180 for a company.

rating.label: Rating
rating.hint: Rate the lead from 1 to 3 stars. Click the active star to clear.

color.label: Card colour
color.hint: Optional colour stripe shown on the lead card.

stage.label: Stage
stage.hint: The current pipeline stage of this lead.
stage.reasonRequired: Moving to {{stage}} needs a reason. Use the lead's actions.
stage.convertRequired: Use Convert to move a lead to {{stage}}.

delete.title: Delete this lead?
delete.text: “{{name}}” will be removed from the list.

leadGone: That lead no longer exists. Moved to the next one.
leadGonePrev: That lead no longer exists. Moved to the previous one.
scopeDenied: You do not have permission to view this lead.
chooseBranch: Choose a branch in the top bar to see leads.
customFieldsDenied: You do not have access to this list. Ask your administrator.
customFieldsFailed: Could not load custom fields. Try again.
